subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this shared durable-runtime substrate as the canonical cross-owner persistence and recovery layer on the 2026.7.1 release line?
rationale: The branch creates permanent database, environment, Gateway protocol, CLI, and session-delivery contracts whose ownership and release scope cannot be decided from implementation correctness alone.

options.title: Sponsor the architecture
options.body: Approve the shared durable substrate in principle, require owner review of overlap with existing ledgers, and gate merge on repaired checks plus live upgrade and delivery proof.

options.title: Narrow the foundation
options.body: Keep only the smallest canonical persistence and runtime primitives, deferring agent, delivery, Gateway, and CLI integration to separately proven PRs.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Do not promote the cumulative stack until maintainers choose a different durable-work ownership model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the architecture
recommendation.body: Approve the shared durable substrate in principle, require owner review of overlap with existing ledgers, and gate merge on repaired checks plus live upgrade and delivery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans core agent, Gateway, session, and release-line product architecture, where current-main history shows the strongest cross-surface ownership signal.
